notes.title: Just announced: Heist Haven
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to Heist Haven, a sprawling, dynamic criminal playground. Dive into an ever-evolving battle between Cops and Robbers in a fresh take on the PvE Heist FPS experience.

Heist Haven is being developed by Somehow Games, a new game studio in the Netherlands, which is developing ambitious games that aim to capture the excitement and wonder that seem so rare in modern video games today.
[/b]

The Development of Heist Haven started in Q4 of 2023 and has progressed steadily since then. Expect to see regular development updates here and on the official game website: [url=heisthaven.com]heisthaven.com[/url].

Currently, the game is in an early state. Many of the game's systems have been completed and are working in a manner that I am happy about, but there's a ton of work left to create content and polish the existing features. It's important to me that the game is released only when it is ready.

I will aim to write a blog post here every quarter or so, capturing the latest state of the game. More frequent updates will be visible on the game's website itself. So, keep an eye out there as well.

Anyway, I'm getting back to working on the game now. See you soon!

~ Justin from Somehow Games
